headline: Sensex gains 700 points led by Maruti Suzuki and HDFC Bank as Nifty tops 25,750

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Maruti Suzuki and HDFC Bank led a 700-point surge in the Sensex.
Nifty crossed the 25,750 level during trading.
SEBI announced plans for faster FPI onboarding to attract foreign capital.
DGCA issued a show cause notice to SpiceJet over operational delays and cancellations.
whatHappening: Sensex surged 700 points as Nifty crossed 25,750 led by banking and auto gains.
DGCA issued a show cause notice to SpiceJet following flight delays and cancellations.
SEBI is planning regulatory reforms aimed at accelerating FPI onboarding.
Midwest Energy secured a 1,200-tonne rare earth magnet project under a central government scheme.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices traded sharply higher with Sensex gaining 700 points and Nifty topping 25,750, driven by gains in Maruti Suzuki and HDFC Bank.
SpiceJet faced regulatory pressure as the DGCA issued a show cause notice regarding recent flight cancellations and delays.
Meanwhile, SEBI is planning fresh reforms to simplify FPI onboarding and attract higher foreign portfolio capital.
